releaseNotes:
Surface async install failures instead of hanging on "Installing"

PackageInstaller reports its terminal status asynchronously to
UpdateInstallReceiver, which had no handle to the controller and only
logged the result. A late failure (e.g. signature mismatch ->
INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE) left the update dialog stuck on
"Installing" forever.

Add UpdateInstallEvents, a process-wide bus the receiver republishes
success/failure to. UpdateController collects it (init-time, guarded to
the Installing/ReadyToInstall window) and maps a failure to
UpdateState.Error(INSTALL) so the dialog shows the real message.

Make UpdateChecker/UpdateDownloader/UpdateInstaller open (no behavior
change) so the new UpdateInstallWiringTest can substitute fakes and
drive check -> download -> install -> async-outcome.
